job.title: Project Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Officer
job.education: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health, or related Engineering field; NEBOSH Certified in IGC1 and IGC2
job.description: Coordinate health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards and compliance across large construction projects or within the manufacturing sector.
job.requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health, or related Engineering field. NEBOSH Certified in IGC1 and IGC2. 2 to 3 years of experience coordinating HSE in large construction projects or the manufacturing sector. Knowledge of construction safety regulations, Ethiopian labor laws, risk assessment, ISO 45001:2018, and ISO 14001:2015.
